_readme: photo-field-tools mapped onto the hub's PALETTES.md §1 ROLES. Run from the hub: node palette-check.mjs ../photo-field-tools/palettes/photo-field-tools.json — the gate is canonical THERE and is never forked. Values are the Instrument family from palettes/families.json, adopted unchanged; nothing here was invented, so §3's coupled-knobs problem does not arise. Token names map as: page=--page, pageAlt=--page-alt, surfaces=[--surface,--surface-2,--surface-3], rail=--rail, hairline=--hairline, text=[--txt,--txt-2,--txt-3], accents.primary=--accent, accentSoftAlpha=the alpha in --accent-soft. All declared in exactly one place, src/styles.css, per §6.
